auth.login.title: Welcome back
auth.register.title: Create an account
auth.password_hint: At least 10 characters. A short sentence works well.
household.setup.title: Household
household.setup.greeting: Hello {name}! Join a household or start your own.
household.join.title: Join a household
household.join.hint: Ask your flatmates for the join code.
household.create.title: Start a household
household.create.hint: You become its admin and can invite the others.
household.field.name: Name
household.members.title: Members
household.code.title: Join code
household.code.hint: Anybody with this code can join the household.
household.code.manual: Copying is not available here — please select the code by hand.
chores.delete_confirm: “{title}” will be deleted together with its history.
chores.empty.title: No chores yet
chores.empty.hint: Add the first one — the templates help you get started.
chores.form.title: Title
chores.form.on_demand: When needed, without a fixed date
chores.form.fixed_hint: Fixed: the date stays on its grid (always Mondays, say) even when the work was done late. Missed rounds lapse.
chores.stats.title: Statistics
chores.stats.reset_confirm: Every score starts at 0 again. The history is kept.
chores.take_over_confirm: Do you want to take “{title}” over from {name}? You get the points, and the next person is up afterwards.
chores.form.on_duty_hint: The order only decides who comes next. Here you set whose turn it currently is.
auth.email_hint: Optional. Kehrwoche does not send mail; the address is only there so you can reset a forgotten password yourself later on.
shopping.clear_confirm: {count} bought items will be removed from the list. The board gets one entry about the shopping trip.
shopping.empty.title: The list is empty
shopping.empty.hint: Write down what is missing — the suggestions save typing.
app.offline: No connection — changes are not being saved.
expenses.empty.title: No expenses yet
expenses.empty.hint: Record the first shared expense — Kehrwoche suggests how to split it.
expenses.filter.label: Filter
expenses.delete_confirm: “{title}” will disappear from the running settlement.
expenses.balances.title: Balances
expenses.balances.hint: Balance = paid − own share. All balances always add up to zero.
expenses.settlement.title: Settle up
expenses.archive.title: Archive
expenses.archive.confirm: All open expenses are frozen and the payments are stored. Balances then start at zero again. This cannot be undone.
feed.empty.title: Nothing has happened yet
feed.empty.hint: As soon as somebody ticks something off, shops or records an expense, it shows up here.
feed.delete_confirm: The post disappears together with its comments and likes.
notifications.title: Notifications
notification.chore_due.title: Chore due
notification.chore_assigned.title: Your turn
notification.chore_reminder.title: Reminder
notification.feed_like.title: Somebody likes it
notification.feed_comment.title: New comment
notification.settlement_due.title: Settlement
notification.settlement_due.body: It is your turn to pay.
settings.password_changed: Password changed. Other devices were signed out.
settings.delete_explains: Your name, address and picture are removed; completions, expenses and pinboard entries of the household stay as “former member”. Signing in is no longer possible afterwards.
household.insecure: This instance runs without TLS: the connection is unencrypted. Only run it this way inside a VPN or behind a TLS reverse proxy.
auth.registration_closed: Registration is closed on this instance. Ask whoever runs the server for an account.
household.currency_hint: The currency is only the label: existing amounts are not converted, they are just printed differently.
household.members.remove_confirm: {name} loses access to the household. Completions, expenses and posts stay and will show as “former member”; open balances remain visible in the kitty.
household.code.regenerate_confirm: The current code stops working immediately. Anybody who already has it can no longer join with it.
household.leave_explains: You are only leaving the household — your account stays. Afterwards you can join another one or found a new one. Your completions, expenses and posts stay in this household and will show as “former member”.
household.leave_confirm: You are about to leave “{name}”. The only way back is to join again, and for that you need the join code once more.
household.leave_last_member: You are the last member: leaving deletes this household together with its chores, shopping list, kitty and pinboard.
household.leave_owed: You still owe the household {amount}. Better settle up first — otherwise it stays unclear who owes what.
household.leave_credit: The household still owes you {amount}. Better settle up first — once you have left you can no longer see the settlement.
settings.delete_owed: You still owe the household {amount}. Your account is deleted all the same — sign-in, sessions, email and picture go immediately. Only your name and login name stay visible in this household's settlement so the open claim stays attributable; once it is settled, they are removed too.
settings.delete_credit: The household still owes you {amount}. Your account is deleted all the same — sign-in, sessions, email and picture go immediately. Only your name and login name stay visible in this household's settlement so the open claim stays attributable; once it is settled, they are removed too.
chores.field.title: title
household.field.takeover_keeps_turn: Taking over does not count as a turn
household.takeover_hint: Doing a chore for somebody else does not hand the turn on — whoever was on duty stays on duty. The due date and the points are unaffected.
